chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a Moroccan young man about 20, short black hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark jeans
chars.UNCLE1: UNCLE1: a Moroccan man in his fifties with a grey moustache, wearing a brown wool djellaba with the hood down
chars.UNCLE2: UNCLE2: a thin bald Moroccan man in his forties with a short black beard, wearing a navy tracksuit with white side stripes
chars.FQIH: FQIH: an old Moroccan man with a long white beard, white djellaba and white turban, holding prayer beads
chars.COUSIN: COUSIN: a skinny Moroccan teenage boy about 15, curly hair, wearing a red football jersey and grey shorts

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night inside an old stone-walled rural house near Agadir, lit by one oil lantern. UNCLE1 and UNCLE2 are secretly digging a deep hole in the dirt floor with a pickaxe and a shovel, sweating, glancing nervously toward the doorway. Seen from a half-open wooden doorway, head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible. Pile of earth, cardboard sheets beside the hole.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, a small bedroom. NARRATOR sits up on his bed holding his phone, the screen glow lighting his surprised face as he reads a new message. Close medium shot, face visible, dark calm background.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, bedroom. NARRATOR leans toward his phone with narrowed suspicious eyes and a half smile, thinking hard, one hand on his chin. Medium shot, face visible.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, bedroom. NARRATOR typing fast on his phone with both thumbs, eager and serious expression, lamp light. Medium shot, face visible.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, outside a small stone house in a dry Moroccan village with almond trees and mountains under the moon. COUSIN stands alone near the wall, holding his phone close to his mouth, whispering a voice message, looking over his shoulder nervously. Medium shot, face visible.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night, inside a crumbling old stone house with a locked wooden door. UNCLE2 stands inside a waist-deep hole handing up a bucket of earth to UNCLE1, who covers part of the hole with cardboard, both looking around secretively. Medium-wide, faces visible, lantern light.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night, old stone room. FQIH sits cross-legged beside a dug hole reading from an old book, a small clay incense burner smoking, while UNCLE1 and UNCLE2 kneel and watch him with hopeful wide eyes. Lantern light, faces visible.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, a dark corridor of a village house. COUSIN hides behind a slightly open wooden door, peeking through the gap with wide shocked eyes, listening, hand over his mouth. Warm light spills from the room beyond. Medium shot, face visible.
